title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(宮田俊弘研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Miyata Toshihiro)
keywords: Display 2.Solar cell 3.Transparent conducting thin film 4.Phosphor 5.Thin film
educationalGoal: To learn the ability to discover the problems and issues necessary for technological development in the electronics field, and the ability to solve and achieve them. The basic knowledge, advanced expertise and engineering sense required for that are acquired through experimentation. Specifically, acquire the research and development ability of materials and devices in the field of optoelectronics, and cultivate the research and development ability of "systems" combining those materials and devices
advice: This subject is the final subject of the design project process, and is regarded as a subject that integrates the items learned in all subjects. Aim to acquire advanced expertise through experiments and studies. 1. Research activities --- Conduct in a research team consisting of (3 to 5 persons) per research theme. The contents of the main research activities of the year are shown in each semester as follows. Previous semester: Review of basic subjects and acquisition of semiconductor materials production and processing basic technology. Then work on developing new materials, devices and systems under specific research themes. Second semester: Following the previous semester, work on developing new materials, devices, and systems under a specific research theme. Then, the results of one year will be put together as research papers and presented to the public. 2. Training for Outcome Reporting --- Provides the following training throughout the year: Training of oral presentations using projectors in front of a large number of people by joint research report of 1.2-3 research groups, training of questions and answers sessions once a week from the previous semester to the middle of the second semester . 4. Conduct discussion training and write research notes daily through meetings on research content within the research group. 5. Work with graduate students to prepare one week's worth of results from the middle of the previous semester.
requiredKnowledge: In Design Project III, we will conduct research activities while manufacturing devices and evaluating their characteristics. Therefore, it is necessary to fully understand the contents of the specialized subjects. In particular, it is important to review and deepen your understanding of what you have learned in electronic physics, semiconductor engineering, electronic device engineering, and electronic application

activityGoals.body: It is possible to approach the problems and issues necessary for technological development.
We can design semiconductor materials and devices.
We can research and develop materials and devices in the field of optoelectronics.
We can research and develop systems that combine materials and devicess.
We can effective discussions and presentations.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) To understand the project theme and master the project design process sufficiently. (2) The results can be summarized as a project report, and presentations can be made at the Design Project III Public Presentation Review Board. (3) In addition to giving excellent results, the results can be made public at academic meetings etc., and can be highly evaluated outside.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Understand the project theme and master the project design process sufficiently. (2) The results can be summarized as a project report, and presentations can be made at the Design Project III Public Presentation Review Board.

lessons.operation: (1) Learn basic matters related to research subjects. (2) Learn how to operate various experimental devices (3) Conduct a discussion at the daily briefing session
lessons.assignments: Submit an activity report every weekend

lessons.operation: 1) Conduct an experiment following the previous semester. 2) Submit an interim report at the end of the year. 3) Summarize the results in a dissertation and make a presentation at the Design Project III Public Presentation Review Board 4) Take over for students in the next fiscal year Summarize the materials.
